items.title: Ukraine and Russia swap 270 prisoners as a local truce in Oleshky is set for 29 October
items.summary: The CFR conflict tracker reports a 270-for-270 prisoner exchange on 23 October facilitated by the US and UAE, and a temporary ceasefire in occupied Oleshky starting 29 October to allow aid and evacuations. It also reports Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure that cut power to over half a million people. These are tracker summaries of early reports, so treat the details as provisional.
items.why: Local truces and prisoner swaps are the first signals of a wider ceasefire, which moves energy prices and sanctions risk that global employers plan around.

items.title: Al Jazeera: Trump says no strikes on Iran for now as Iran warns against renewed attacks
items.summary: Al Jazeera's front page leads with Trump saying there would be no strikes on Iran 'today', while Iran replied that renewed US-Israeli attacks would 'achieve no different outcome'. It also reports Qatari mediators visiting Tehran. The situation is fluid and the page is a live headline summary, so details are provisional.
items.why: Tension in the Gulf feeds oil prices and investor risk appetite, which affect hiring budgets and consumer demand.

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO allotment is set for today, with listing expected on 28 October
items.summary: Chittorgarh and HDFC Sky list basis of allotment for the Rs 30,213 crore Jio Platforms issue as 26 October, refunds and demat credit on 27 October, and listing on BSE and NSE on 28 October (tentative). Overall subscription is put at about 22.19 times, with qualified institutional buyers at 70.55 times, though one tracker shows 21.36 times, so the figure is provisional. Price band is Rs 1,065 to 1,119.
items.why: The largest consumer-tech listing in India shows how markets value subscriber scale and brand strength, a useful lens for marketing strategy.

items.title: WWT and DDN launch an AI storage design for NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks
items.summary: IT Brief reports that WWT and DDN released a storage reference design for AI factory campuses of 50 megawatts and above, built around NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 systems with storage sized for 72-GPU racks. It is a vendor announcement and has not been independently tested.
items.why: AI infrastructure is turning into a productised B2B market, and positioning in it is a marketing problem as much as an engineering one.

items.title: Cursor's Computer Use lets coding agents operate any desktop app
items.summary: AI Weekly's digest for 25 October lists Cursor's Computer Use, announced on 23 October, which lets its agents click and type across desktop applications rather than only the browser.
items.why: Agents that use ordinary software change which HR and marketing tasks can be automated.
